id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description: The name of the recommendation category.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

description.description: Description of the {@link UserRecommendation}s this recommendation category is generating.

autoDismissTriggeringUser.description:
Whether or not any recommendation generated by {@link generateRecommendation} is automatically dismissed for the current user (as defined by `c3Context().username`).
Useful if recommendations are directly triggered by user actions.

inactive.description: Specifies whether or not this recommendation category is currrently enabled to generate {@link UserRecommendation}s.

recommendationGenerator.description: The user-defined API to call which will generate {@link UserRecommendation}s.

title:
Type which specifies the logic to generate {@link UserRecommendation}s which are recommended actions
that users should take on a specific type.
name: UserRecommendationCategory
